components.name: Item 13 spec (owner-authored, 2026-07-17)
components.what: The owner's canonical pronoun-drift problem spec: 5 true-positive shapes (TP1 beat-mismatch, TP2 alibi-clearance drift, TP3 investigator-masculinized cross-sentence, TP4 cross-beat mixing, TP5 nearest-name capture), 3 must-not-flag precision shapes (FP1 legit referent, FP2 unnamed-role, AMB group-ambiguity), high-risk scene classes, a 4-part fix architecture, an editing checklist, and a verbatim generation instruction for a P5 prompt lever. Bottom section records the 2026-07-17 fixture-audit results run through the real shipped machinery.
components.scope: Fixture source and requirements doc for all Item-13 work; explicitly maps every fix onto existing machinery ('nothing here is a new subsystem').
components.knownLimitations: The spec itself notes the externals' verbatim drift quotes were never recorded (47fe3c20 summarized without quotes); shapes are owner-reconstructed, not transcript-derived.

components.name: Fixture audit harness (spec architecture prerequisite: measure-then-fix)
components.what: IMPLEMENTED (commit 047d469f, 2026-07-17). Runs every TP/FP/AMB spec shape through the real shipped detector and repair sweep BEFORE any code change. Verdict recorded in the spec (lines 79-97): repair already fixed TP1/TP2/TP4; detector was 1/5 blind and fired the FP2 false positive; TP3 untouched by repair; TP5/AMB genuinely ambiguous.
components.scope: One-shot audit script; also scripts/pronoun-audit.mjs (A_62 RC-4, 2026-07-16) which ran the real detectPronounDriftEvents over the S0 stories with designed casts.
components.knownLimitations: Audit fixtures are the spec's synthetic shapes, not recovered external quotes; the RC-4 audit found the S0-era 0/20 cap history is partly version skew (the S0 rubric never ran the pronoun scan at all — ANALYSIS_62.md:272).

components.name: Spec fix-arch #1: fixed pronoun map before drafting (frozen Bible gender map)
components.what: IMPLEMENTED pre-spec (bf96b516, 2026-07-03, A_61 RC2.2): genderMapFromBible dereferenced as the single authoritative pronoun source for validators + narrative state, behind AGENT9_BIBLE_AUTHORITATIVE (agent9-run.ts:257, default false in code, ON via env per ledger cap panel line 144). Prompts DO surface it per character: pronoun tags on personality headers (packages/prompts-llm/src/agent9-prose/prompt-blocks.ts:213-214, 282-283), compact per-cast PRONOUN LOCK block (prompt-builder.ts:2036-2039), ABSOLUTE PRONOUN LOCK retry guidance (generate.ts:2712-2715), and 'PRONOUN LOCK — never change' lines in regen and critique-rewrite prompts (regen-llm.ts:54, critique-rewrite.ts:108).
components.scope: Generation-time + regen/rewrite-time prompt surface across the whole Agent-9 stack.
components.knownLimitations: The spec's sub-task 'Verify prompts actually surface it per character' has no recorded verification artifact; the surfacing is confirmed only by code inspection here. Ran ON for all 20 cap-ledger runs yet all 4 external reads still saw drift (TARGET_80_LEDGER.md:144) — the map alone does not prevent generation-time drift; the probe-#1 reviewer's ROLE-contamination class defeats it.

components.name: Spec fix-arch #2: AGENT9_PRONOUN_CLARITY generation-instruction lever
components.what: NOT IMPLEMENTED. Zero hits for AGENT9_PRONOUN_CLARITY in any .ts/.js/.mjs/.json in the repo — it exists only in ANALYSIS_62.md and the spec. The spec required a default-OFF prompt lever carrying the owner's verbatim instruction (pronoun map + name-over-pronoun in dense scenes + drafting-time consistency pass), A/B'd at P5 measuring drift-event count AND dialogue/prose marks. The 7.4 decision sitting (2026-07-20) kept the candidate LIVE (character_clarity 6.19 < 6.5) but as corpus-era design (ANALYSIS_63.md:120); 7.9 close-out lists it among open carry-overs (ANALYSIS_63.md:125). The A/B era then ENDED (7.3 was 'the campaign's last A/B batch') without it ever being built or measured.
components.scope: Would have been the owner's editing checklist + verbatim instruction (spec lines 58-75) as prompt copy; also the designated home for TP5/AMB handling.
components.knownLimitations: Because this lever was never built, spec fix-arch #4 (name-substitution repair) and TP5 recall are also unimplemented — 047d469f explicitly routed both here. Now effectively superseded by the probe-#1 'PRONOUN ROLE-CONTAMINATION' work item (CRAFT_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md:23-24), queued as the top craft blocker for the next sitting, still not root-caused.

components.name: Spec fix-arch #3a: detector precision fix (FP2 unnamed-role suppression)
components.what: IMPLEMENTED (047d469f). UNNAMED_ROLE_INTERVENER (line 250-251): a period staff/occupational + generic-person noun list; detectImpossibleSelfReferences skips a wrong-pronoun hit when an unnamed role noun precedes it (line 302) — reproducing and killing the RC-4 live FP ('the night porter … clearing his throat'). Precision-first posture: any person-role noun suppresses regardless of gender coding.
components.scope: Detector (b) impossible-self-reference, narration only (dialogue stripped, line 263); feeds pronounInstabilityEvents/pronounsUnstable cap.
components.knownLimitations: Deliberately high-precision/low-recall (documented at lines 299-301); the fixture audit showed the detector remains blind to TP2/TP3/TP4/TP5 even after this fix — only its FP noise was removed. Fixed noun list can miss novel role nouns.

components.name: Spec fix-arch #3b: repair recall fix (TP3 — Guard C existence requirement)
components.what: IMPLEMENTED (047d469f). Guard C previously protected any >=2 opposite-pronoun run as 'probably a different character'; it now requires that hypothesized different character to actually EXIST — someone of that gender named in the paragraph (evidence base built at line 439) — before protecting the run. This lets the sweep repair self-consistent whole-sentence drift ('He pressed on toward the shore, his gaze fixed.' after an Eleanor sentence with no male named). Cross-paragraph-INHERITED anchors keep the unconditional guard (lines 422-426). Same commit fixed the pronoun-verify-policy cross-paragraph window mismatch (competitor search widened to the test's ±200-char window; suppression only widens).
components.scope: repairPronouns/repairChapterPronouns — the deterministic sweep invoked from agent9-run.ts:1635, 1649, 2476, 2746.
components.knownLimitations: Title-as-evidence override (line 482) and mixed-gender-paragraph guards remain heuristic; TP5 nearest-name capture is untouched by design (genuinely ambiguous — needs name substitution, which was never built).

components.name: Spec fix-arch #4: AMB name-substitution repair
components.what: NOT IMPLEMENTED — deliberately. The spec requires ambiguity repaired by replacing the pronoun with the intended NAME, never by flipping gender ('a wrong flip corrupts; a name is always safe'). Commit 047d469f states verbatim: 'TP5 + AMB name-substitution deliberately NOT attempted (genuinely ambiguous → the P5 AGENT9_PRONOUN_CLARITY prompt lever, per the spec)' — and that lever was never built.
components.scope: Would target the AMB shape and TP5; also the editing-checklist rules (names over pronouns in deduction/reveal scenes, no ambiguous pronouns after group descriptions).
components.knownLimitations: No code path anywhere performs name substitution for ambiguous pronouns; the highest-risk scene classes the spec lists (group interrogations, reveals, alibi-clearing) have no concentrated detection/repair targeting either.

components.name: D5 monotonic sweep guard + pronoun-stability validator (pre-spec machinery the spec builds on)
components.what: A_57 D5 (486f3c48, plus f6386e47's R-B sweep 2026-06-24): buildPronounStabilityValidator (line 2058) counts pronoun_gender_mismatch via CharacterConsistencyValidator for mutateThenValidate; applyDeterministicPronounSweep (line 2457) runs repairPronouns with crossParagraphInheritance and REVERTS the whole chapter if countChapterPronounMismatches rises (lines 2486-2495 — the monotonic guard); applyPronounGuardedMutation (line 5400) wraps later post-processing mutations (grounding-lead, etc.) so they revert when they raise the mismatch count. applyTargetedPronounSweep (lines 1611-1649) re-repairs only validator-named characters.
components.invokedFrom: Agent 9 post-processing chain (post-LLM, per-chapter), lines 5478 and 5561 for the guarded mutations.
components.scope: The deterministic backstop layer — the spec's architecture item 3 'exists' claim points here.
components.knownLimitations: countChapterPronounMismatches only scores sentences naming exactly one gender (line 2446) so it under-counts; MEMORY-documented trap: post-processing runs AFTER validation, so passes outside the guard can still corrupt clean output; M1v8-2 shipped 3 surviving pronoun majors — the sweep demonstrably misses shapes (spec line 54).

components.name: A/B pronoun telemetry (what 'pronoun 13.3→15.0' actually measures)
components.what: pronounTokenTotals (line 35) = descriptive gendered-pronoun token totals, explicitly 'NOT a correctness metric'; pronounSignals (line 47) = pronoun/misgender/re-gender warning strings, 'the honest guardrail signal'; guardrail check no_new_pronoun_signals (line 112) requires treatment <= control. The ledger's P5.2-DV 'pronoun 13.3→15.0' treatment dip (TARGET_80_LEDGER.md:21) is this token-total metric on arms the lever never touched — explicitly attributed to story variance, not causation. The P3/P4 scaffold verdict accepted 'one +1 pronoun signal' regression against 17 hits removed (TARGET_80_LEDGER.md:18; agent9-run.ts:204 comment).
components.scope: A/B analyzer for all flag experiments (scaffold, dual-value, voice, critique-rewrite batches).
components.knownLimitations: No A/B ever measured drift-event count as the spec's lever protocol required (the pronoun-clarity A/B never ran); token totals cannot distinguish drift from cast composition.

keyFindings: SPEC STATUS SUMMARY — of the Item-13 spec's four fix-architecture requirements: #1 (frozen Bible gender map before drafting) EXISTS pre-spec (bf96b516, agent9-run.ts:255-257) and prompts do surface per-character pronouns at 6+ sites (prompt-blocks.ts:213-214/282-283, prompt-builder.ts:2036-2039, generate.ts:2712, regen-llm.ts:54, critique-rewrite.ts:108); #2 (AGENT9_PRONOUN_CLARITY generation lever, default-OFF, P5 A/B) NEVER BUILT — zero code hits, doc-only, kept 'LIVE' at the 7.4 sitting (character_clarity 6.19 < 6.5) but the A/B era closed (7.3 was the last batch) before it ran; #3 (post-processing pass: measure current repair vs each TP shape, then fix) FULLY DONE via scripts/pronoun-fixture-audit.mjs + commit 047d469f (FP2 unnamed-role suppression at prose-consistency-validator.ts:250-302, TP3 Guard-C existence requirement at pronoun-repair.ts:439/497-503, cross-paragraph window alignment; 414/414 green); #4 (AMB name-substitution repair, never gender-flip) NOT BUILT — 047d469f deliberately routed TP5+AMB to the never-built #2 lever, so they remain unhandled. The editing checklist and verbatim generation instruction (spec lines 58-75) are likewise unimplemented prompt copy for the missing lever. Commit-message claims in 047d469f check out against the code.

FAILURE HISTORY (prompt-rule era, Mar-Apr 2026): the first fix generation was prompt rules — ANALYSIS_17 Issue II (Critical) introduced the ABSOLUTE PRONOUN LOCK block (ANALYSIS_17.md:210) + retry hard-lock feedback; ANALYSIS_19 found the 9-rule block + deterministic sweep only reduced drift to 1-2 retries/chapter, never eliminating it (A9-PR-1), and identified antecedent-chain migration (A9-PR-4). ANALYSIS_20 delivered the killing diagnosis: the LOCK block sits at priority 0, 3,000+ tokens from the generation context, 'effectively invisible' by chapter 5 (ANALYSIS_20.md:146); the narrator defaults masculine when the POV name isn't in the preceding clause (A20-PR-2); per-character CML gender can flip mid-run (A20-PR-3). Note: the task brief's 'ANALYSIS_16 Phase D locks' is a mislabel — ANALYSIS_16 has essentially no pronoun content; the lock block is ANALYSIS_17's Refactor #2, autopsied in ANALYSIS_20. The re-gendering lesson (full-chapter LLM rewrites re-gender during reconstruction, fixed by phrase-level substitution) survives as the 'whole-chapter re-gender scar, LLD §6.4' (ANALYSIS_61.md:205) and ANALYSIS_59 P3.3's insertion-only preservation guard 'blocks re-gendering'.

FAILURE HISTORY (measured-repair era, Apr-Jun 2026): repair volumes stayed high and stubborn — ANALYSIS_21 §2.6: 14-18 repairs per attempt on Ch5-8, NOT decreasing across retries ('the model is not registering the pronoun table'); ANALYSIS_26: 15 pronoun errors were validator FALSE POSITIVES from alias incompleteness (the first documented detector-precision failure, foreshadowing RC-4); ANALYSIS_27: sweep fixed 34 issues yet ChatGPT still found he→she errors, with pronoun_validation_enabled:false; ANALYSIS_45 D4 (June): 'pronoun sweep: 17 repairs' with residual errors surviving to the shipped story; ANALYSIS_58: 11 repairs/10 chapters (~1/chapter persistent drift). ANALYSIS_59 (ChatGPT): pronoun errors were 'the biggest reason the score is not closer to 80'.

FAILURE HISTORY (deterministic-guard era, Jun-Jul 2026): f6386e47 (2026-06-24) shipped the R-B pronoun sweep; A_57 D5 (486f3c48) root-caused pronoun_policy=off + post-processing-mutates-after-validation, and built buildPronounStabilityValidator + the monotonic guard (applyDeterministicPronounSweep reverts a chapter if the sweep RAISES mismatches, agent9-run.ts:2486-2495; applyPronounGuardedMutation:5400 wraps later mutation passes); bf96b516 (2026-07-03, A_61 RC2.2) froze the Bible gender map as the single source (AGENT9_BIBLE_AUTHORITATIVE).

FAILURE HISTORY (detector-inversion era, Jul 2026): the internal pronounsUnstable cap read 0/20 while ALL FOUR 2026-07-13 external reads saw drift (TARGET_80_LEDGER.md:144) → Item 13. The A_62 RC-4 audit (2026-07-16, scripts/pronoun-audit.mjs) inverted the diagnosis: (1) the S0-era rubric never ran the pronoun scan at all — the 0/20 history is partly VERSION SKEW; (2) the current detector's only firings on S0 stories were 2 false positives; (3) it yields zero events on the drift externals saw → BOTH precision and recall gaps, and hardening it would only add false caps (ANALYSIS_62.md:271-276). Live-run corroboration: 30 moderate pronoun_drift FPs on M1v8-2 (every character, 'opposite-gender pronoun nearby' in mixed-gender scenes); pronoun ×3 majors helped tip the class-#8 abort (M1v9-8).

MEASUREMENT RECORD: the only A/B numbers ever attached to pronouns are (a) 'one +1 pronoun signal' — an accepted magnitude-1 regression in the P3/P4 scaffold verdict (TARGET_80_LEDGER.md:18), and (b) 'pronoun 13.3→15.0' in P5.2-DV (TARGET_80_LEDGER.md:21) — which is pronounTokenTotals, a DESCRIPTIVE gendered-token count explicitly 'NOT a correctness metric' (analyze-lib.mjs:34-35), on treatment arms the dual-value lever never touched, and the ledger itself labels it story variance. The spec's required measurement (drift-event count + dialogue/prose marks under a pronoun-clarity A/B) was never taken.

CURRENT STATE (2026-07-22): the probe-#1 external reviewer found SEVERE drift on mystery-1784751055781 despite every layer above being live, and diagnosed a class outside the spec's five shapes: ROLE-pronoun contamination — pronouns assigned from the role's historical occupant (prior drafts' female investigator Eleanor) rather than the character holding it (male Hugo Vane). CRAFT_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md:24 ranks it 'the top craft blocker'; the reviewer estimates fixing it alone reaches 84-87 external. It is queued for the next sitting and NOT yet root-caused — the drift instances live in the story artifact + prompt archive (documentation/prompts/actual/run_20260722-2010_mystery/).

PATTERN ACROSS SIX MONTHS: every era's fix worked at its own layer and was defeated one layer upstream — prompt locks failed to context distance (A_20), sweeps failed to shape blindness (fixture audit: detector 1/5), the frozen gender map failed to generation-time role priors (probe #1). The two deliberate gaps today are (1) the unbuilt AGENT9_PRONOUN_CLARITY generation-side lever (which the spec designated for exactly the generation-time class now biting) and (2) TP5/AMB name-substitution repair, which was routed into that lever. Commit timeline: da82652a/b2f055b2/e595f17f (2026-05-14 first pronoun review) → f6386e47 (06-24 R-B sweep) → 486f3c48 (A_57 D5) → 2e32d698/3ef0d2aa (A_57/A_58 fixes) → bf96b516 (07-03 RC2.2 pronoun-lock) → 047d469f (07-17 Item-13 fix) → 034f7972 (07-22 probe-#1 external read).
